seoTitle: DPSCD Calendar 2026–27: Key Dates, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: DPSCD students start Aug. 24, 2026. The scheduled last day is June 7, 2027. See breaks, PD days, conferences, official PDFs, and .ics download.
heroSummary: DPSCD students start Monday, August 24, 2026, and the scheduled last day is Monday, June 7, 2027. Thanksgiving recess runs November 25–27, Winter Break December 21–January 1, Mid-Winter Break February 16–19 after the February 15 district holiday, and Spring Break March 29–April 2. DPSCD uses separate parent-teacher conference dates for grades 9–12 and K–8.
calendarNotes: Students begin August 24 after two district PD days, a teacher workday, and two schools-closed dates. District In-Person PD days are student closures, but gray school-based PD markers are not automatically no-school days. High-school conferences fall October 14 and March 17, one week before the K–8 conferences on October 21 and March 24. The calendar uses four quarter boundaries and report-card dates on November 11, February 3, and April 19, with the final quarter ending on the last student day. Dark-red dates close schools while the District remains open; orange District Recognized Holidays close both. Students are scheduled to finish June 7, while June 9–17 is a conditional make-up window rather than confirmed attendance. The English family PDF has official Arabic, Bengali, French, Pashto, and Spanish translations; individual school calendars remain necessary for bell times, GSRP PreK dates, activities, tests, and changes.

customSections.label: Which DPSCD PD Days Mean No School?
customSections.content: District In-Person PD days are no-school days for students. School-based PD dates may be replaced by staff meetings and do not automatically mean students are off.

customSections.label: DPSCD Conference Dates by Grade Band
customSections.content: DPSCD schedules high school conferences one week before K–8 conferences in both semesters. Conference dates are not marked as districtwide no-school days, so families should confirm school hours and student schedules.

customSections.label: June 9–17 Are Make-Up Days Only If Needed
customSections.content: DPSCD has reserved June 9–17 for student and staff make-up if an emergency closure or low staff attendance at a districtwide PD day requires it. The scheduled last day for students remains June 7, and the reserved dates are excluded from calendar downloads unless DPSCD announces that they will be used.

calendarFaqs.q: When is DPSCD Winter Break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar marks schools closed from Monday, December 21, 2026, through Friday, January 1, 2027. December 25 and January 1 are District Recognized Holidays within that range.

calendarFaqs.q: When is DPSCD Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 29, through Friday, April 2, 2027. The preceding Friday, March 26, is also a District Recognized Holiday.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for DPSCD students in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The scheduled last day for students is Monday, June 7, 2027. June 9–17 is only a conditional make-up window.
